_comment: Canonical Consensus document shape. client is the authority - it stores ConsensusPolicy records that define named consensus bodies for L2 governance. A Consensus consists of N member identities (enrolled agentic apps) and requires K affirmative distinct signatures to reach quorum. A field mismatch breaks L2 governance and multi-sig verification.
_consumers: client internal services (L4 Warden, governance verification)

consensus._description: Named consensus body for L2 governance. Consists of N member identities (enrolled agentic apps via TrustedSigner.ID) and requires K affirmative distinct signatures to reach quorum.

id.description: Consensus name/identifier. Used as the document ID.

member_app_ids.description: Member app IDs enrolled in this consensus. Each ID corresponds to a TrustedSigner.ID.

quorum.description: Number of affirmative distinct signatures required to reach quorum (K-of-N).

require_distinct.description: Whether duplicate signer keys are rejected. When true, each signature must come from a distinct signer.

app_id.description: Primary application ID hosting the deliberation endpoint.

endpoint_url.description: HTTPS deliberation endpoint URL for the bound consensus application.

provider.description: Vote producer of the bound consensus. Empty means application, so bindings written before providers existed keep working.

model_tag.description: Pinned vote model tag. Tribunal provider only; must be empty for the application provider.

model_digest.description: Pinned vote model digest. Tribunal provider only; must be empty for the application provider.

allow_hosted.description: Explicit hosted egress opt-in. Requires a versioned Jev tag and no digest; provenance is hosted-unpinned.

enabled.description: Whether this consensus is currently enabled for governance participation.
